description: This file defines the Messenger class, which implements plugin and room notification interfaces for a messaging system within the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions for handling message notifications, user join/leave events, and JSON-RPC endpoint registration.

classes.name: Messenger
classes.description: Main plugin class that manages messaging rooms and notifications, implementing plugin and room notification interfaces, including JSON-RPC endpoints for joining, leaving, and sending messages.

classes.name: Messenger::MsgNotification
classes.description: Handles message notifications received from rooms, forwarding them to the Messenger for processing.

classes.name: Messenger::Callback
classes.description: Handles user join and leave events within a room.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Messenger plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the Messenger plugin.

methods.name: JoinRoom
methods.description: Joins a specified room with a given user name.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified room.
